newsitem.title: JORDAN: PLO's Arafat in Jordan for talks with King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat in Jordan for talks with King Hussein.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in the Jordanian Red Sea resort of Aqaba on Wednesday to see Jordan's King Hussein, who is recuperating at his seaside palace after prostate surgery, officials said.

They said Arafat was met by Crown Prince Hassan at Aqaba airport and given a state welcome by a bedouin guard of honour before heading to the palace for a day of talks on the stalled Israeli-Palestinian peace process.

Arafat was expected to seek the king's support to put pressure on Israel to implement peace accords and relaunch the process, which plunged into crisis after Israel's decision to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

The king's intervention helped early in the year to seal a long-delayed accord on Israeli troop withdrawal from 80 percent of the West Bank town of Hebron and a timetable for further redeployment from the West Bank.
